title: I got beat up for the first time in mallworld?
content: I have experienced other violence but this was the first time i was beat up, by a guy with a baton. He hit me in the kneecap and busted it, and i felt the whole pain and it was bad. I was worried if it would heal without a doctor. I remember that we were in a parking lot type area near a walking path that had metal railings and i tried to use the railings to stand up and defied this guy. Idk what he wanted but i wasnt listening so he bashed my knee.
